dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical narrowing from the wide mid-body section towards the posterior peduncle, following a smooth parabolic arc.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and continuous with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations at the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-grey to light-grey median intensity; visible skin tone indicates a sub-adult or transitional color phase between slate-grey and white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey shading is concentrated along the posterior dorsal ridge and the lateral-posterior flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradient transitions between light and dark grey zones are gradual with no sharp lines of demarcation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several fine, light-colored linear scratches (rake marks) are visible on the mid-left dorsal surface; isolated small white punctate marks are present.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, superficial linear epidermal markings consistent with intraspecific rake marks on the posterior half of the visible dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark circular aperture (blowhole) positioned at the anterior midline.
